name: IEA 10MW Monopile
subtitle: Fixed-bottom · 30 m depth · 10 MW
description: IEA 10-198-RWT reference turbine on a monopile substructure in 30 m water depth. Rotor diameter 198 m, hub height 128 m above MSL. Full offshore simulation: SeaState (JONSWAP, Hs=4.52 m, Tp=9.45 s), HydroDyn Morison strip theory, SubDyn flexible monopile (D=9 m). ROSCO controller.
notes: Fixed-bottom offshore: CompSeaSt=1, CompHydro=1, CompSub=1, CompMooring=0. ROSCO DISCON.IN patched for ROSCO 2.10.x (F_VSRefSpdCornerFreq). ElastoDyn platform DOFs all False (SubDyn handles platform dynamics). HydroDyn and SubDyn files updated to OpenFAST 4.x format.
